abstract: For a prime power $q=p^e$ with $p\equiv3$ or $5\pmod8$, let $Y_q$ be the minimal resolution of the double cover of the degree-$2q$ Fermat surface branched along its coordinate hyperplane sections. We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for every finite product of these surfaces, allowing arbitrary primes, exponents and repetitions, and products with the elliptic curve with complex multiplication by $\mathbf Q(i)$. A parity character identifies Aoki's order-two gap group in degree $4q$ and vanishes on the relevant surface characters. The argument also includes cyclic diagonal quotients whose defining character has an even number of entries congruent to $2\pmod4$. For primes $p>3$ with $p\equiv3\pmod8$, we develop the explicit family $S_p:r^4=x^3-tx+t^{(p+3)/2}$. An elliptic quotient of its genus-three fibers constructs a simple CM factor $A_p$ of dimension $p-1$ in the Jacobian of a cyclic prime cover of one fixed genus-six curve. Algebraically split half-twist realizations extend the product theorem to these factors, including cases with degenerate Hodge tori. We determine exactly when the tori are full norm-one tori, construct explicit norm tensors and associated Weil classes, and compute the minimal-model invariants of $S_p$. The unresolved exceptional degree-$44$ mixed correspondence is distinguished from the classes constructed here. The general Hodge conjecture remains open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout

title: Hodge classes on products of Fermat double covers and explicit CM factors
